question_text: Let f(x) = ∫ [(16x + 24)/(x² + 2x − 15)] dx. If f(4) = 14 ln(3) and f(7) = ln(2^α · 3^β), where α, β ∈ N, then α + β is:
solution: Partial fractions give (16x+24)/[(x+5)(x−3)] = 7/(x+5)+9/(x−3). Thus f(x)=7ln|x+5|+9ln|x−3|+C. The condition f(4)=14ln3 gives C=0. Then f(7)=7ln12+9ln4=32ln2+7ln3, so α+β=39.

subject: Mathematics
question_text: Let x=x(y) be the solution of 2y²(dx/dy) − 2xy + x² = 0, y > 1, with x(e)=e. Then x(e²) is:
solution: Set x=yz. The differential equation reduces to 2y(dz/dy)+z²=0, so 1/z=(1/2)ln y+C. From x(e)=e, z(e)=1 and C=1/2. Hence x=2y/(1+ln y), giving x(e²)=2e²/3.
